title: mris_ca_label
description: Produces an annotation file in which each cortical surface vertex is assigned a neuroanatomical label using a previously-prepared atlas file.

canonsurf.description: Name of the spherical surface file that describes the registration of a subject's vertices to the average surface
canonsurf.title: Canonical Surface File

outputfile.description: Output annotated surface file listing the region label for each vertex
outputfile.title: Annotated Surface Output File

seed.description: Specify the seed for the random number generator
seed.title: Seed

long_flag.description: Refines the initial labeling read-in from -r (default: disabled)
long_flag.title: Longitudinal Refinement Flag

novar_flag.description: Sets all covariance matrices to the identity (default: disabled)
novar_flag.title: No Variance Flag

f.description: Applies mode filter <number> times before writing output (default=10)
f.title: Mode Filter Applications

t.description: Specify parcellation table input file (default: none)
t.title: Parcellation Table Input File

p.description: Output file containing label probability for each vertex.
p.title: Label Probability Output File

w.description: Writes-out snapshots of gibbs process every <number> iterations to <filename> (default=disabled)
w.title: Gibbs Process Snapshots
